# ssp_telemetry_data (Data Source)

Exports the platform's aggregated telemetry data as a raw file dump — not a structured resource. `data` is the exact bytes returned by the API, decoded as a string (a CSV document by default); this data source does not parse or interpret its contents.

Corresponds to `GET /ssp/telemetry/data`.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `format` (String) Export format to request from the API. Defaults to `csv`.

### Read-Only

- `data` (String) Raw exported telemetry data, in the requested `format`.
